body:
Coordinator rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-15 22:20Z, agreed with Engram::Fable after TermAl load caused an Engram gate failure). During the OTHER project's FULL GATE, TermAl runs NOTHING CPU- or IO-heavy: no npm ci, vitest (even focused), tsc, fixture generation, measurement runs or cargo. Allowed: reads, mail, edits, a single-file rustfmt --check, git-only steps and read-only reviewer pairs. Engram follows the same rule.

Cause: Engram's w-f9368 gate test-93f1a2fc (21:42-22:17Z) failed on host contention: its freeze stage took 646 s against a normal 105-230 s, and a launcher test hit its 60 s timeout. In that window I had approved Sol-a7bb's npm ci, repeated focused vitest runs, and a 1,356-item Engram fixture build plus a 136-page `ls` measurement, all during Engram's gate. Engram's w-c47d failure at 20:37Z overlapped similar UI work and a reviewer pair.

Practice: before granting ANY run, check whether a gate is running on either side. If one is, the run waits for that gate's END, then goes in an agreed build window.

22:21Z, the same evening, a crossing miss. Engram::Fable offered a window (#2202) while I offered its re-gate first (#2203); it took my offer and launched (#2205, #2206). Meanwhile I accepted its earlier #2202 and sent four GOs at 22:19Z. I revoked them at 22:20Z, but Opus3's cold cargo build (test-a75ff97c) had already started and overlapped Engram's quiet gate. RULE: when messages with the other coordinator cross, send NO worker GO until the other coordinator has explicitly confirmed the slot in a message that replies to my latest. If messages cross again, the other side's latest decision wins.

ADDITION (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-16 02:03Z). `git worktree add`, a full checkout of a few hundred MB, is DISK-HEAVY and is NOT allowed during the other project's gate. Engram's w-7e87 gate test-e7f46a48 failed at about 02:00Z on a SQLite concurrent-open race (SQLITE_PROTOCOL, Engram w-b44744a4e474). TermAl had created three fresh worktrees between 01:55 and 02:00Z (Sol-edfd, Opus3, Sol-license) because I allowed "git worktree and naming" during gates. Causation is unproven, but stop allowing it. During the other project's gate allow only: mail, edits in EXISTING worktrees, read-only review pairs, git status/diff, and freeze checks. Create new worktrees in TermAl windows.

Addendum (2026-10-16 05:02Z). Engram's w-b447 phase-3 full lib suite took 654 s instead of the usual 355–410 s and failed one Windows exchange fixture with Err(Deadline), while TermAl ran the P0's cold cargo build, a --no-run compile and the GREEN, all under the agreed "focused runs may go in parallel with (1) and (2)". Lesson: a COLD cargo build or a full test-binary compile is gate-class load. Keep it out of the other project's suite or timing phases too, not only out of its full gates. Warm focused runs are fine.
